value.description: On the fringes of interstellar civilization, {PAWN_nameDef} showed an unusual talent for building from an early age. On forgotten colonies, {PAWN_pronoun} learned to raise sturdy fortifications and practical housing with almost no resources. {PAWN_possessive} hands could turn scrap from ruins into useful structures, a skill worth a great deal to anyone surviving on the rim. {PAWN_pronoun} mastered every construction technique available and learned to plan the most efficient layouts for a hostile environment.
